This position is known as the "Gillibrand Amendment" or the "Pro-Life Amendment".

Gillibrand introduced the amendment to the Senate in 2009, which aimed to prohibit federal funding for abortions and to require that states that wish to fund abortions pass separate legislation authorizing such funding. The amendment was later incorporated into the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) as the Hyde Amendment.
